node: Election, identity verification, cybersecurity, and public-safety systems
summary: Layer 1B expansion found that most certified voting-system vendors are private, so the US-listed direct universe is concentrated in adjacent government software, public-safety communications, and trusted-identity providers. The two-lane list uses Motorola Solutions as the obvious public-safety reference anchor, Tyler Technologies as a public-sector software leader, and Telos/CLEAR as more direct identity-verification discovery names tied to TSA PreCheck enrollment and biometric identity workflows. Election-machine exposure remains a coverage gap because ES&S, Dominion/Liberty Vote, Clear Ballot, Hart InterCivic, IDEMIA, CentralSquare, and several NG911 specialists appear private or non-US-listed.
